bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'GAYBBS_CONTAINERS_BEGIN\n'
docker ps --format '{{.Names}}|{{.Image}}' | grep -Ei 'gaybbs|postgres' || true
printf 'GAYBBS_CONTAINERS_END\n'
printf 'STARTLESS_SOURCE_BEGIN\n'
test -f artifacts/bot/scripts/refreshStartlessExistingPosts.ts && echo REFRESH_SCRIPT_PRESENT || true
test -f artifacts/bot/dist/scripts/refreshStartlessExistingPosts.js && echo REFRESH_BUILT_PRESENT || true
test -f artifacts/bot/src/services/startlessExistingPosts.ts && echo SERVICE_SOURCE_PRESENT || true
printf 'STARTLESS_SOURCE_END\n'
printf 'STARTLESS_DB_BEGIN\n'
pg="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei 'postgres' || true)"
if [ -n "$pg" ]; then
docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'psql -X -q -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d gaybbs -At -F "|" -c "SELECT to_regclass(\x27public.startless_public_post_migrations\x27); SELECT state,COUNT(*) FROM startless_public_post_migrations GROUP BY state ORDER BY state;"' || true
fi
printf 'STARTLESS_DB_END\n'
echo STARTLESS_RUNTIME_PREFLIGHT_FINISHED
